articles.title: North Korea says it tested long-range cruise missiles
articles.summary: North Korea recently announced it fired long-range strategic cruise missiles into the sea, claiming it was a test of its nuclear deterrence. This development follows apparent progress in its submarine construction program and coincides with ongoing joint US-South Korea military exercises. Pyongyang views these exercises as provocative, intensifying regional tensions and highlighting its persistent defiance of international sanctions and non-proliferation norms.

articles.title: N. Korea says long-range missiles tested
articles.summary: North Korea recently test-fired long-range strategic cruise missiles into the sea, explicitly stating their purpose was to assess and enhance the nation's nuclear deterrence capabilities. This significant military drill follows recent reports of advancements in their missile construction programs, underscoring ongoing tensions and Pyongyang's commitment to strengthening its strategic arsenal.

articles.title: Why ISRO's BlueBird Block-2 Satellite Launch Matters? | India Enters New Era of Space Broadband [3:08]

articles.title: Do fins really matter?
articles.summary: This article highlights the critical role of fins in propulsion, particularly in aquatic environments. Fins are essential for achieving efficient movement, significantly impacting speed and maneuverability. Understanding the science behind fin design and function is crucial for various applications, from biological locomotion to advanced underwater vehicle development, emphasizing engineering solutions for optimized performance and control.

articles.title: North Korea’s Kim oversees test launch of long-range cruise missiles
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un oversaw the test launch of long-range strategic cruise missiles and called for the unlimited development of nuclear combat forces. This action highlights North Korea's continued military advancements and its commitment to bolstering nuclear capabilities, raising international concerns regarding regional stability and arms proliferation.
